subject.title: Feishu: read image tool result loses media before final outbound payload

question: Should maintainers make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 the canonical current-file fix for this issue, or ask https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50359 to be refreshed as the direct issue-specific fix?
rationale: The issue is valid and source-reproducible, but two open PRs overlap with different freshness and scope, so automation should not queue a third fix or close this issue before a maintainer chooses the landing path.

options.title: Use the current-file shared PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 as canonical for the shared read-image media bridge, have it explicitly reference this issue, and require its proof and CI gaps before merge.

options.title: Refresh the direct PR
options.body: Ask https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50359 to rebase or port from the removed `pi-*` files if maintainers prefer the reporter's narrower branch.

options.title: Split Feishu residuals
options.body: Keep this issue scoped to the read-tool bridge while leaving direct Feishu `MEDIA:` and fallback-security behavior to the newer Feishu-specific reports.

recommendation.title: Use the current-file shared PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 as canonical for the shared read-image media bridge, have it explicitly reference this issue, and require its proof and CI gaps before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current media bridge and handler history point to this owner as the best available router for choosing the canonical agent-runtime landing path.
